prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Caesium (Cs) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a small repair kiosk with a cluttered workbench, a low stool, tools hanging on the wall and an open shutter onto the street
Weather / season: autumn — falling leaves and warm low light outside.
Time of day: early morning — low clean light, long soft shadows.
Hair: her hair tied up in a loose bun or ponytail — same colour and length as the attached image, a few strands loose.
Light direction: two-colour light — warm indoor light on one side, cool daylight or dusk on the other.
Outfit: a mechanic's coverall with its top half peeled down and the sleeves tied at the waist over a fitted cropped tank top, work boots — in clean neutrals such as white, ivory, oatmeal or soft grey; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 60-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 40-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body in side profile, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; head turned back over her shoulder; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a small sealed glass ampoule holding a bead of soft pale-gold metal up beside her face; it is all she holds.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: one brow raised higher, eyes wide and attentive, lips slightly parted.

Framing: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — caesium: a soft, pale-gold alkali metal that melts in a warm hand at about 28 degrees and explodes on touching water, the most violently reactive of the stable alkali metals, so it is kept sealed in glass ampoules under inert gas; found in 1860 in boiled-down spring water, the first element ever discovered with the spectroscope, and named from Latin caesius, sky blue, for the two bright blue lines in its flame; since 1967 the second is defined as 9,192,631,770 vibrations of the caesium atom, counted by atomic clocks — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
acceptance: user chose 1,1,1 and authorized main publication

observations: Original verified 1024x1536; one adult woman in focus; reference face/hair colour and painterly rendering followed.
Visible bent arm and hand connect naturally and hold the sealed ampoule beside her face; second arm cropped.
